jobs.title: Associate, Product Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
About This Role
About BlackRock CCB Wealth Management Limited:
BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being and the firm has a long history of investing in and serving investors in China. BlackRock aspires to become the leading global asset management firm operating in China and is committed to contributing to the long-term development of the local asset management industry. BlackRock CCB Wealth Management Limited (China WMC) – a Shanghai-based joint venture between BlackRock, China Construction Bank and Temasek – aims to deliver investment excellence by offering customer-centric, diversified and innovative wealth management products and solutions to help Chinese people secure a better financial future and retire with dignity.
Role Description
The role will be responsible for driving the broad activities of product team within WMC.
Core to the role is an ability to create and articulate strategic plans relating to existing and future products, taking into consideration client, industry, market, regulatory and technology trends. A key deliverable is the oversight and execution of product development initiatives in partnership with colleagues and clients.
The individual will more particularly support the creation and syndication of a strategic product roadmap for the WMC. He/she will also play a key role, in partnership with other functions, in executing on this roadmap: legal, financial and operational fund structuring, regulatory/licensing, product positioning in the marketplace, etc. In this respect, it is expected that he/she will have an intimate understanding of the onshore China fund market, both in the public and private fund spaces.
The ideal candidate has a strong interest in market/industry research, product design and structuring, possesses quantitative and analytical skills, is able to solve problems creatively, combined with a passion for driving commercial outcomes. Prior exposure to a broad range of investment products across different asset classes, including internationally, is necessary to succeed in this role.
Responsibilities Include
Establishing operational procedures and governance pertaining to the launch and ongoing management of all Wealth Management Products on offer within the WMC
Conducting studies on the local industry landscape, competitor research, and client/market trends
Working with the team to design and articulate product priorities, new ideas business cases, and longer-term product strategy, including critical gap analysis
Support the product design and structuring process, manage the product approvals process, and oversee the end-to-end implementation process
Support the maintenance of existing products, working with numerous stakeholders to reposition products for the purpose of enhancing commercial performance, or eliminate products, as appropriate
Partner with Legal teams to create and maintain offering documentation
Support the maintenance and evolution of the product governance framework
Help create and maintain key reference documents, related to new product ideas and existing product suite
Qualifications
7+ years of relevant experience in financial services, preferably in asset/fund management. Working experience in NAFR regulated wealth management company is a plus.
Strong understanding and prior exposure to the China mutual fund and wealth management industry – familiarity of regulatory frameworks (NAFR) pertaining to the offering of WMPs, product pipelines, competitors, and of launching WMPs, system buildup and internal processes.
Experience in facing / dealing with regulators and retail/institutional clients
Charted Financial Analyst (or working towards) or comparable qualification is a plus
Skills
Native/exceptional in Chinese (Mandarin, simplified) and fluency in English is a plus
Strong project management, organizational and problem solving
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment, and own delivery against tight deadlines and constraints
Strong analytical abilities, including attention to detail and affinity for data analysis
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including ability to coordinate across multiple functions, geographies and senior stakeholders across the firm
Effective in operating in an open, interactive, collegial environment
Sound and unbiased judgment, professionalism and discretion
High level of self-motivation, with strong integrity and ethics
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools
Our Benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

jobs.title: Analyst, Quantitative Researcher
jobs.descriptionText:
About This Role
BlackRock China Fund Management Corporation (FMC):
BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being and the firm has a long history of investing in and serving investors in China. BlackRock aspires to become the leading global asset management firm operating in China and is committed to contributing to the long-term development of the local asset management industry. BlackRock China Fund Management Company, a Shanghai-based wholly-owned subsidiary of BlackRock, aims to extend its asset and risk management expertise and offer Chinese investors innovative and diversified mutual fund products and investment solutions to help transform more cash savers into long-term investors.
Role Description
BlackRock is looking to continue its expansion in China with talented individuals who can truly drive the business to the next level. We are currently looking for an experienced professional with minimum 2 years of quantitative research or investment experience, plus a strong desire to advance his/her career to take up the role of Analyst, Quantitative Researcher, with a focus on Equity or Multi-Asset. We will also consider exceptional candidates with strong experience who are returning to the industry. The position will be based in Shanghai and report to the CIO of Equity, MASS and Index at China FMC.
This role is expected to produce quantitative research and drive investment process according to business needs. In addition, this analyst will provide comprehensive support for offline IPO, including drafting stock valuation reports, driving offline processes, maintaining investment pool , etc. Furthermore, this role will be highly involved in team daily operations with report automation, performance / risk analytics and other ad-hoc tasks. The role is expected to progress towards ranked researcher or junior portfolio manager after a few years, depending on business needs and the candidate’s capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Perform rigorous quantitative research (in areas like equities, fixed income, macro, CTA etc.) to generate candidate investment strategies. Write research reports on the signals and models. Productionize the signal generation systematically to be used in live products, after passing the required research approval process.
Follow the market, macro and policy development on the daily basis. Automate data collection/analytics generation to produce regular reports.
Work with RQA and IT teams to understand the risk analytics infrastructure, help to produce risk decomposition and performance attribution reports. Produce ad-hoc due diligence reports on issuers to maintain investment pools – leveraging quantitative insights as well as discretionary judgements on the issuers’ fundamentals.
Report to the CIO of Equity, MASS and Index directly while collaborating with the team members, as well as other relevant teams (investments, trading, RQA, ops, tech, L&C etc.) both locally and across the globe.
Process driven - track and update China offline IPO deals and relevant data. Write stock research reports - conduct financial analysis, build valuation models and provide pre-IPO pricings. Drive product-specific investment allocations in a timely and orderly manner.
Qualifications, Knowledge And Experience
Minimum 2 years of quantitative investment & research experience in areas like equities, fixed income, macro, CTA etc., from reputable financial institutions. Experience in quantitative equity strategies, cross-asset quantitative research, and model-based quantitative strategies are highly preferred. Exposure to the global markets is a plus.
Ability to independently conduct quantitative investment research. Ability to synthesize own work into research papers. Ability to communicate clearly with global teams. Past experience in implementing quant signals from research methodology papers (can be academic papers) is preferred.
Self-driven and hard-working. Able to simultaneously drive multiple work streams from start to finish, while prioritizing critical business needs. Remain focused amid stressful market periods and despite working long hours.
Familiarity with China onshore offline IPO would be a plus, such as the full end-to-end process, valuation, post-allotment follow-up arrangements etc.
Strong coding skill (Python preferred) . Advanced academic degrees preferred but not necessary. CFA, CIPM and other related professional qualifications preferred.
Our Benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
